numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, you gain a bonus to your next damage roll against a target you hit with a melee attack during the current turn. The bonus equals +{@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|psi} per psi point spent, and the bonus damage is the same type as the attack. If the attack has more than one damage type, you choose which one to use for the bonus damage.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為一個附贈動作，你在當前回合內下一次對被你的近戰攻擊擊中的生物的傷害骰上獲得額外加值。額外加值等於每花費1點psi點，+{@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|PSI}，並且額外傷害的型別與攻擊相同。如果攻擊有多種傷害型別，你可以選擇用於額外傷害的型別。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: When you hit a target with a melee attack, you can activate this ability as a reaction. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked 10 feet away from you per psi point spent. The target moves in a straight line. If it hits an object, this movement immediately ends and the target takes {@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|psi} bludgeoning damage per psi point spent.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你使用近戰攻擊命中一個目標時，你可以將此能力作為反應啟用。目標必須進行一次力量豁免檢定，若失敗則每消耗1點靈能點數，目標會被擊退10英尺。目標沿直線移動。如果它撞到物體，此移動立即結束，並且目標每消耗1點靈能點數受到 {@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|PSI} 鈍擊傷害。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, you increase your walking speed by 10 feet per psi point spent until the end of the current turn. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為附贈動作，你每花費1點psi點數就可以使你的行走速度增加10尺，直到當前回合結束。如果你有攀爬或游泳速度，這個增加也適用於那個速度。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you deliver a touch of acid to one creature within your reach. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|psi} acid damage per psi point spent on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為一個動作，你對範圍內的生物施加酸性觸擊。目標必須進行一次敏捷豁免，如果失敗，則每花費1點psi點受到{@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|PSI}點強酸傷害，如果成功則受到一半的傷害。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, one creature you can see within 60 feet of you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d8} psychic damage per psi point spent, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為一個動作，你可以看到的60尺範圍內的一個生物必須進行一次魅力豁免。如果豁免失敗，它將受到每花費1點psi點{@damage 1d8}點心靈傷害，並且在它的下一個回合開始之前不能進行反應。如果豁免成功，它受到的傷害減半。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: If you spend 1 minute conversing with a creature, you can attempt to seed it with overwhelming ennui. At the end of the minute, you can use an action to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition charmed}. On a failed save, it sits and is {@condition incapacitated} until your {@status concentration} ends. This effect immediately ends if the target or any ally it can see is attacked or takes damage. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected and has no inkling of your attempt to bend its will.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 如果你花費1分鐘與一個生物交談，你可以嘗試在它心中種下難以忍受的厭倦感。在1分鐘結束時，你可以使用一個動作強迫生物進行一次感知豁免。如果目標對被{@condition charmed||魅惑}免疫，則豁免自動成功。如果豁免失敗，它將坐下並處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，直到你的{@status concentration||專注}結束。如果目標或它能看到的任何盟友被攻擊或受到傷害，這個效果會立即結束。如果豁免成功，生物將不受影響，並且對你的意志控制嘗試毫無察覺。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you force one creature you can see within 60 feet of you to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} psychic damage, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. You can increase the damage by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-7|1d6|psi} per additional psi point spent on it.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你迫使你能看到的60尺範圍內的一個生物進行一次魅力豁免檢定。豁免失敗，它受到{@damage 3d6}點心靈傷害，並且它的速度在它下一個回合結束前降低到0。豁免成功，它受到的傷害減半。你可以每多花費1點psi點數增加{@scaledamage 3d6|3-7|1d6|PSI}點傷害。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|psi} psychic damage per psi point spent and can't move closer to you until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，選擇一個你能看到的60尺範圍內的生物。目標必須進行一次魅力豁免檢定。如果失敗，它每花費1點psi點會受到{@scaledamage 1d6|1-7|1d6|PSI}點心靈傷害，並且在它的下個回合結束前不能靠近你。如果成功，它受到的傷害減半。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: If you spend 1 minute conversing with a creature, you can attempt to leave a simmering violence in its mind. At the end of the minute, you can use an action to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw to resist feeling violent urges against one creature you describe to it or name. The save automatically succeeds if the target is immune to being {@condition charmed}. On a failed save, the target attacks the chosen creature if it sees that creature before your {@status concentration} ends, using weapons or spells against a creature it was already hostile toward or unarmed strikes against an ally or a creature it was neutral toward. Once the fight starts, it continues to attack for 5 rounds before this effect ends. This effect immediately ends if the target or any ally it can see is attacked or takes damage from any creature other than the one it has been incited against. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected and has no inkling of your attempt to bend its will.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 如果你花1分鐘與一個生物交談，你可以嘗試在其心中留下醞釀的暴力。在1分鐘結束時，你可以使用動作強迫生物進行一次感知豁免檢定，以抵抗對你描述或命名的一個生物產生暴力衝動。如果目標對{@condition charmed||魅惑}免疫，則豁免檢定自動成功。投擲失敗，目標會在你的{@status concentration||專注}結束前，如果看到被選定的生物，就會攻擊那個生物，使用武器或法術對付它已經敵對的生物，或對盟友或它原本中立的生物進行徒手攻擊。一旦戰鬥開始，它會在這種效果結束前繼續攻擊5輪。如果目標或它能看到的任何盟友被除了它被煽動攻擊的那個生物之外的任何生物攻擊或受到傷害，這種效果會立即結束。如果豁免檢定成功，生物不受影響，並且不知道你試圖彎曲其意志的嘗試。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a reaction when you make an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you gain a +1 bonus to that saving throw for each psi point you spend on this ability. You can use this ability after rolling the die but before suffering the results.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你進行感知、感知或魅力豁免檢定時，作為反應，你每花費1點psi點數，就可以在該豁免檢定上獲得+1的加值。你可以在使用骰子投擲之後但在遭受結果之前使用這個能力。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you gain a +1 bonus to AC for each psi point you spend on this ability. The bonus lasts until the end of your next turn. This bonus applies against the triggering attack.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 當你被攻擊擊中時，作為反應，你每花費1點psi點數，就可以獲得+1的AC加值。這個加值持續到你的下一個回合結束。這個加值適用於觸發的攻擊。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, you cloak yourself in unsettling psychic energy. Until your {@status concentration} ends, any enemy within 60 feet of you that can see you must spend 1 extra foot of movement for every foot it moves toward you. A creature ignores this effect if immune to being {@condition frightened}.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為一個附贈動作，你用令人不安的心靈能量將自己籠罩。直到你的{@status concentration||專注}結束，任何能看到你的敵人，如果在60尺內向你移動，每向你移動一尺，都必須額外花費一尺的移動力。如果生物對{@condition frightened||恐懼}免疫，則忽略此效果。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, choose up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet of you. Each target gains 3 temporary hit points per psi point spent on this effect.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為附贈動作，選擇你能看到的60尺範圍內的最多三個生物。每個目標每花費1點psi點數獲得3點臨時生命值。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As part of your move on your turn, you can fly up to 20 feet for each psi point spent. If you end this flight in the air, you fall unless something else holds you aloft.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為你回合中移動的一部分，你可以每花費1點psi點數飛行20尺。如果你在飛行結束時停留在空中，除非你被其他東西支撐，否則你會下落。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

On a failed save, the target takes {@scaledamage 1d8|1-7|1d8|psi} cold damage per psi point spent and has its speed halved until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你對一個你能看到的120尺範圍內的生物投擲一個冰點。目標必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，目標每花費1點psi點受到{@scaledamage 1d8|1-7|1d8|PSI}點寒冷傷害，並且其速度減半，直到你的下一個回合開始。如果豁免成功，目標受到的傷害減半。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|psi} necrotic damage per psi point spent on this ability, or half as much damage on a successful one.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，選擇一個你能看到的60尺範圍內的生物。目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定，如果失敗，則每花費1點psi點受到{@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|PSI}點暗蝕傷害，如果成功，則受到的傷害減半。

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you unleash a jet of water in a line that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Strength saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, you can move each target that fails its saving throw to any unoccupied space touching the line. You can increase this ability's damage by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-7|1d6|psi} per additional psi point spent on it.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你釋放出一道60尺長、5尺寬的水線。在這條線上的每個生物都必須進行一次力量豁免檢定，如果失敗，則受到{@damage 3d6}點鈍擊傷害，如果成功，則受到一半的傷害。此外，你可以將每個未能透過豁免檢定的目標移動到與該線接觸的任何未被佔據的空間。你可以每多花費1點psi點數，將這個能力的損害增加{@scaledamage 3d6|3-7|1d6|PSI}。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you conjure forth clouds to create a solid, translucent staircase that lasts until your {@status concentration} ends. The stairs form a spiral that fills a 10-foot-by-10-foot area and reaches upward 20 feet per psi point spent.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為動作，你召喚雲朵創造出一個堅固、半透明的樓梯，這個樓梯將持續存在，直到你的{@status concentration||專注}結束。樓梯形成一個螺旋形，佔據一個10尺乘10尺的區域，並且每花費1點psi點，樓梯向上延伸20尺。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: Arabic and written-number/fraction forms are equivalent

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, you create a wall of thunder, at least one portion of which must be within 60 feet of you. The wall is 60 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall lasts until your {@status concentration} ends. Every foot moved through the wall costs 1 extra foot of movement. When a creature moves into the wall's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or it takes {@damage 6d6} thunder damage, is pushed in a straight line up to 30 feet away from the wall, and is knocked {@condition prone}.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為一個動作，你創造一堵雷鳴之牆，至少有一段必須在你60尺範圍內。這堵牆長60尺，高15尺，厚1尺。牆在你{@status concentration||專注}結束前一直存在。每穿過牆的1尺需要額外1尺的移動力。當生物在一個回合內首次進入牆的空間或在其內開始回合時，該生物必須進行一次力量豁免，否則它將受到{@damage 6d6}雷鳴傷害，被直線推向遠離牆30尺處，並被擊成{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。
numericEquivalentDifferences.reason: same numeric value set; repetition/formatting only

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As an action, your mind seizes control of a one-handed melee weapon you're holding. The weapon flies toward one creature you can see within 30 feet of you and makes a one-handed melee weapon attack against it, using your discipline attack modifier for the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the weapon deals its normal damage, plus an extra {@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|psi} force damage per psi point spent on this ability. The weapon returns to your grasp after it attacks.

numericEquivalentDifferences.english: As a bonus action, you imbue one ranged weapon you hold with psionic power. The next attack you make with it that hits before the end of the current turn deals an extra {@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|psi} psychic damage per psi point spent.
numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 作為附贈動作，你將靈能力量注入你所持有的一件遠端武器中。在當前回合結束之前，你用它進行的下一次攻擊如果命中，則每花費1點psi點數額外造成{@scaledamage 1d10|1-7|1d10|PSI}點心靈傷害。

numericEquivalentDifferences.localized: 如果你在你的回合中還沒有移動，你可以使用附贈動作進行傳送，每花費1點psi點可以傳送20尺到一個你能看到的未被佔據的空間，並且你的速度在回合結束前減少到0。
